items.name: Premium Starter Pack
items.desc: A welcome bundle of purely visual flair: an exclusive glowing Blockling skin, a radiant Heart Tree, island decorations and a founder nameplate.

items.name: Premium Edition
items.desc: The complete cosmetic collection: every Heart Tree and building reskin, both environment effects and a unique Premium nameplate. Visual only.

items.name: Radiant Heart Tree
items.desc: Bathes the Heart Tree in a soft golden glow. Cosmetic reskin only.

items.name: Ancient Heart Tree
items.desc: A gnarled, moss-draped elder tree with carved runes. Cosmetic reskin only.

items.name: Blossom Heart Tree
items.desc: Covers the Heart Tree in drifting pink blossoms. Cosmetic reskin only.

items.name: Crystal Heart Tree
items.desc: Reshapes the Heart Tree into living crystal that catches the light. Cosmetic reskin only.

items.name: Rustic Lumber Grove
items.desc: A weathered timber-and-rope makeover for the Lumber Grove. Cosmetic reskin only.

items.name: Marble Stone Quarry
items.desc: Veined white marble dressing for the Stone Quarry. Cosmetic reskin only.

items.name: Prism Crystal Mine
items.desc: Refracted rainbow facets for the Crystal Mine. Cosmetic reskin only.

items.name: Grand Research Library
items.desc: An ornate domed facade for the Research Library. Cosmetic reskin only.

items.name: Lantern Grove Decorations
items.desc: Scatters hanging paper lanterns and warm string lights across the island. Cosmetic decoration only.

items.name: Zen Garden Decorations
items.desc: Raked sand, stepping stones and a quiet koi pond for the island. Cosmetic decoration only.

items.name: Grand Festival Decorations
items.desc: Banners, bunting, confetti and a central maypole dress the island for a festival. Cosmetic decoration only.

items.name: Firefly Ambience
items.desc: Gentle drifting fireflies around the island at dusk. Cosmetic ambience only.

items.name: Falling Leaves Ambience
items.desc: A soft, continuous drift of falling leaves across the view. Cosmetic ambience only.

items.name: Autumn Forest Pack
items.desc: Amber foliage, a harvest Heart Tree and drifting leaves for the autumn season. Cosmetic theme only.

items.name: Winter Kingdom Pack
items.desc: A frosted crystal Heart Tree, snow-dusted island and lantern lights for the winter season. Cosmetic theme only.

items.name: Celestial Festival Pack
items.desc: Starlit banners, fireflies and a grand festival island under the night sky. Cosmetic theme only.

items.name: Spring Blossom Pack
items.desc: A blossoming Heart Tree and a serene zen garden for the spring season. Cosmetic theme only.

items.name: Extra Cosmetic Loadout Slot
items.desc: Adds one extra saved cosmetic loadout so you can store a favourite look. Organizational only; does not affect gameplay.

items.name: Cosmetic Loadout Slot Pack
items.desc: Adds three extra saved cosmetic loadouts for quickly switching between saved looks. Organizational only; does not affect gameplay.

items.name: Glimmer Pip Skin
items.desc: An exclusive softly-glowing recolour for your starter Blockling, Pip. Cosmetic reskin only.

items.name: Eternal Heart Tree
items.desc: A hand-painted collectible Heart Tree you can mint to your Blockle wallet as a BLOCK-721 NFT. You own it on-chain; the game simply shows it. Cosmetic only.

items.name: Aurora Pip Skin
items.desc: A collectible aurora-lit recolour for Pip, mintable to your Blockle wallet as an NFT. On-chain ownership unlocks the look in your world. Cosmetic only.

items.name: Starfield Isle
items.desc: A collectible starlit island dressing, mintable as a BLOCK-721 NFT in your Blockle wallet. Display-only in the game. Cosmetic only.

items.name: Aurora Veil
items.desc: A collectible shimmering aurora over your world, mintable to your Blockle wallet as an NFT. Cosmetic only.
